Senior Product Engineer — AI Operator (Contract)

Ever Tech · Remote from any time zone

A contract for a senior engineer to lead client engagements and coordinate a team of AI agents.

Responsibilities

  • Lead one or two client engagements or a team.
  • Review AI agent output, make architecture decisions and mentor engineers.

Requirements

  • At least 6 years shipping software, including 2 years responsible for a product or team.
  • Expertise in at least one company stack and experience operating several AI agents in parallel.
  • Ability to lead client calls and create delivery plans.

Conditions

  • Remote contract with hourly pay.
  • Payment through Upwork or by direct invoice.
